note: The High npm cache path into the release was judged overstated: the writers the path names are pull_request runs, whose cache lives under the pull request merge ref and is never restored by the release, so only a writer of the default branch reaches it, Medium at most; the High `dorny/paths-filter@v4` path was judged overstated: a mutable third-party action in a CI job with no secret and no write token (or only an assumed one) gives code execution on a runner, Medium at most. Corrected after reading the workflows: a push run whose job is entered through an unauthorized mutable action (a High dependency path of the same repository) also writes the default-branch cache, so the cache path holds at that writer's High ceiling. No job here declares cache-mode, so GitHub keeps the cache of every low-trust run read-only and grants no job cache write: ISSUE-705 is silent and no cache path exists, so the cache ceiling admits none.
